properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:eu-central-1:303974373642:log-group:/devops-lab/nginx/access" |
fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message /"(?<method>\S+) (?<path>\S+) HTTP\/(?<http_version>\S+)" (?<status>\d{3})/
| filter status >= 400
| stats count(*) as errors by path, status
| sort errors desc
| limit 20
properties.title: Top Nginx Error URLs

properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:eu-central-1:303974373642:log-group:/devops-lab/nginx/access" |
fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message /(?<client_ip>\S+) \S+ \S+ \[[^\]]+\] "(?<method>\S+) (?<path>\S+) HTTP\/[^"]+" (?<status>\d{3})/
| filter status >= 400
| filter client_ip != "::1" and client_ip != "127.0.0.1"
| stats count(*) as errors by client_ip
| sort errors desc
| limit 10
properties.title: Top External IPs Causing Errors

properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:eu-central-1:303974373642:log-group:/devops-lab/nginx/access" |
fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message /(?<client_ip>\S+) \S+ \S+ \[[^\]]+\] "(?<method>\S+) (?<path>\S+) HTTP\/[^"]+" (?<status>\d{3})/
| filter ispresent(status)
| stats count(*) as requests by status
| sort requests desc
properties.title: HTTP Status Codes

properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:eu-central-1:303974373642:log-group:/devops-lab/nginx/access" |
fields @timestamp, @message
| stats count(*) as requests by bin(5m)
properties.title: Nginx Request Rate

properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:eu-central-1:303974373642:log-group:/devops-lab/nginx/access" |
fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message /"(?<method>\S+) (?<path>\S+) HTTP\/[^"]+"/
| stats count(*) as requests by method
| sort requests desc
properties.title: Requests by HTTP Method

properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:eu-central-1:303974373642:log-group:/devops-lab/nginx/access" |
fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message /"(?<method>\S+) (?<path>\S+) HTTP\/[^"]+"/
| stats count(*) as requests by path
| sort requests desc
| limit 15
properties.title: Top Requested URLs

properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:eu-central-1:303974373642:log-group:/devops-lab/nginx/latency" |
fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message /request_time=(?<request_time>[0-9.]+)/
| stats avg(request_time) as avg_response_time,
        max(request_time) as max_response_time,
        pct(request_time, 95) as p95_response_time
  by bin(5m)
| sort @timestamp asc
properties.title: Nginx Response Time

properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:eu-central-1:303974373642:log-group:/devops-lab/nginx/latency" |
fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message /"(?<method>\S+) (?<path>\S+) HTTP\/[^"]+" (?<status>\d{3})/
| parse @message /request_time=(?<request_time>[0-9.]+)/
| stats avg(request_time) as avg_response_time by path
| sort avg_response_time desc
| limit 10
properties.title: Slowest Nginx URLs

properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:eu-central-1:303974373642:log-group:/devops-lab/nginx/access" |
fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message /(?<client_ip>\S+) \S+ \S+ \[[^\]]+\] "(?<method>\S+) (?<path>\S+) HTTP\/[^"]+" (?<http_status>\d{3})/
| filter ispresent(http_status)
| fields concat(substr(http_status, 0, 1), "xx") as status_class
| stats count(*) as requests by status_class
| sort requests desc
properties.title: HTTP Status Classes (2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx)

properties.query:
SOURCE "arn:aws:logs:eu-central-1:303974373642:log-group:/devops-lab/nginx/access" |
fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message /"(?<method>\S+) (?<path>\S+) HTTP\/[^"]+" (?<status>\d{3})/
| filter status >= 500 and status < 600
| stats count(*) as errors by bin(5m)
| sort @timestamp asc
properties.title: 5xx Errors Over Time
